subject: Dedicated VPC + KMS — sizing, SLOs and cost model
messages:
From: procurement@acme-cloud.com
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off procurement for a dedicated inference environment and need a pricing model from Redwood for a VPC-hosted Dedicated pool with customer-managed keys and enhanced audit logging. High level:

- Workload: production real-time generation for customer-facing features (~1.2M tokens/day currently, expected to grow 3x in 6 months)
- Desired SLOs: p95 latency < 120ms for 512-token prompts, 99.9% uptime SLA
- Requirements: single-tenant VPC (no multi-tenant co-location), BYOK (KMS/HSM integration), immutable audit logs retained 1 year, SOC2 evidence and periodic export for audits
- Procurement timeline: vendor selection by 12/20, contract signed by end of year

Please send an initial cost model: reserved commit tiers (monthly), GPU pool sizing guidance, throughput guarantees, and any add-on premiums for isolation/compliance. Also include guidance on how to reduce unit costs (e.g., batching/quantization options) and expected lead times for Dedicated provisioning.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Head of Procurement
Acme Cloud Solutions

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme-cloud.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear brief. I've looped in Neha from Sales to coordinate commercials and Ben for sizing/arch. Attached a rough Dedicated_Sizing_Matrix and our standard Redwood_Dedicated_Terms_v2 for reference. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can give a tighter quote:

- Current steady-state RPS or tokens/sec (not just daily) — helps pick batch profile
- Typical generated sequence length (avg/95th)
- Is BYOK mandatory at contract signature or can it be phased to GA?

High-level guidance (initial):
- GPU pool: for your growth trajectory we recommend starting with a 6-GPU pool (A100-equivalent) with autoscale to 12 for peak bursts; this gives ~2.5–3.5M tokens/day sustained depending on prompt mix
- Commits: we tier commits at monthly spend bands (3, 6, 12 month). 12-month commits reduce unit costs by ~18–22% vs on-demand.
- Isolation/compliance premium: baseline single-tenant VPC + BYOK + daily immutable logs typically carries an isolation uplift — we use a default of ~25% on top of committed unit rates to cover capacity reservation, audit tooling, and KMS operational costs; we can discuss structuring this as a fixed monthly add-on instead of a percentage if you prefer predictability
- Throughput guarantees: we can commit to throughput SLOs per model route (p95 latency targets + token/sec minima) with credits for missed SLOs; exact numbers depend on pinned model version and sequence length distribution

I'll let Neha quote specific numbers once you confirm token/sec and desired commit length. Availability: Dedicated provisioning to a VPC generally takes 4–6 weeks post-signature + onboarding.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Dedicated_Sizing_Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Dedicated_Terms_v2.pdf (term sheet)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme-cloud.com, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request — preliminary bands

Jordan / team —

Following up with concrete bands based on the sizing assumptions Soojin included. Numbers below are illustrative; final pricing will be confirmed in the quote PDF.

Assumptions: 512-token avg, peaks at 2,000 concurrent tokens; model family = open-llama-65B (perf baseline).

Pricing bands (monthly committed spend):
- Tier A (3 GPU reserved pool): baseline unit = $X per GPU-hour; monthly commit target: ~$25k–$35k; isolation uplift: +28%
- Tier B (6 GPU reserved pool): baseline unit = $X per GPU-hour; monthly commit target: ~$48k–$72k; isolation uplift: +25%
- Tier C (12 GPU reserved pool): baseline unit = $X per GPU-hour; monthly commit target: ~$90k–$140k; isolation uplift: +22%

Discounting:
- Multi-month commitments (12 months) qualify for an incremental 6–8% off committed unit pricing.
- If Acme agrees to minimum monthly throughput targets (SLA-backed), we can reduce the isolation uplift by up to 5 percentage points (e.g., 25% -> 20%) because it reduces our idle-reservation risk.

Compliance add-ons (one-time + recurring):
- BYOK integration: one-time engineering integration fee (estimate provided in formal quote) + per-month key-handling operational surcharge (covers HSM ops and rotation).
- Audit log retention & export: base 90-day retention included; 12 months retention (immutable export) is an add-on.

Next steps: if you can confirm the token/sec and whether BYOK must be in day-1, Ben can provide the throughput mapping and revised GPU counts. Happy to put this into a formal quote for signature.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <security@acme-cloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Park <solutions@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request — a couple of security clarifications

Thanks — a few security-specific items before we proceed to a firm quote:

- BYOK: we require BYOK (customer-owned key material) and the ability to perform key rotation on our schedule. Can Redwood support a flow where we upload keys to your HSM and Redwood never has persistent access?
- Key escrow / emergency access: what is Redwood's policy if Acme's keys are lost or revoked?
- Audit logs: logs must be tamper-evident and we need a way to export a monthly snapshot (S3 export) for our auditors. Is that supported?
- Encryption in transit: we need mTLS between our front-end and the Dedicated pool; confirm supported certs and CA rotation process.

Attached: SOC2-Audit-Summary.pdf (summary of their SOC artifacts) — please confirm what additional evidence Redwood can provide for the security review.

Jordan
Head of Procurement & Security
Acme Cloud Solutions

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <security@acme-cloud.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request — technical and commercial clarifications

Jordan —

Short answers to the security questions and a few sizing clarifications:

- BYOK: we support customer key import into a dedicated HSM instance. Redwood will not persist plaintext key material. We support KMS proxying where you control rotation; we can implement a policy that prevents Redwood operators from exporting keys.
- Key escrow / emergency access: we provide an emergency recovery process which is documented and requires 2-party approvals from Acme + Redwood legal; this is treated as a controlled operation and can be scoped in the contract (we can optionally exclude it if you prefer no escrow).
- Audit logs: we can provide write-once export snapshots to your S3 bucket daily; logs are tamper-evident (append-only with signed digests). Retention beyond 90 days is an add-on; we'll include the export automation in the integration phase.
- mTLS: supported for the front-door with certs you provide; Redwood rotates its internal certs independently — we’ll publish a rotation schedule.

Sizing notes:
- With the 3x growth projection, 6 GPUs is tight during peak—we recommend planning the committed pool around expected peak token/sec, then rely on autoscale bursts to handle unexpected spikes.
- If Acme needs strong p95 latency guarantees for 512 tokens, plan to commit to the Tier B or C pool so we can reserve headroom; that deterministically reduces the isolation uplift.

Commercial options to reduce overall cost:
- Structure the isolation costs as a fixed monthly compliance add-on rather than a percentage; this often makes budgeting easier for procurement teams.
- Commit longer (24 months) or commit to a higher minimum monthly throughput and we can offer a deeper discount on unit rates (Neha will include an explicit table).

I'll draft a technical appendix for the quote that spells out integration steps, expected timelines, and the KMS/RBAC controls.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: SOC2-Audit-Summary.pdf (received)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme-cloud.com, security@acme-cloud.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated VPC + KMS pricing request — summary & next steps

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and helpful questions. Summary of what Redwood will include in the formal quote (that's attached in PDF form):

1) Sizing & commit recommendation
   - Recommended starting configuration: Tier B (6 GPU reserved pool) with autoscale to 12 for bursts (covers your 3x growth trajectory with headroom).
2) Commercials (high level)
   - 12-month commit: baseline unit pricing with an 18% effective discount vs on-demand (includes multi-month commit discount).
   - Isolation/compliance: offer a structured approach — two options:
       a) Percentage uplift (applies to unit rates): 20% (reduced from the initial 25% given explicit throughput commit)
       b) Fixed compliance add-on: $6,500 / month (alternative to percentage; choose whichever fits procurement needs)
   - BYOK integration: one-time engineering integration fee (TBD in final quote) + monthly key-handling surcharge.
3) SLAs & SLOs
   - p95 latency target for 512 tokens: <120ms; throughput guarantee agreed in the quote with credits for misses.
4) Deliverables & timeline
   - Dedicated provisioning to VPC: 4–6 weeks after signature + key provisioning window.
   - Technical appendix with KMS flow, audit export automation, and runbook (Ben to supply).

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm you prefer the percentage uplift (20%) or the fixed add-on ($6.5k/mo).
- Acme: confirm BYOK must be live at day-1 or if we can phase it (affects integration fee).
- We will issue a formal quote + technical appendix by EOD MON 12/6. Legal will prepare a mark for your review.

If we can lock the economics this week, we can meet your procurement timelines for signature before 12/31.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Terms_v2.pdf (term sheet), Dedicated_Sizing_Matrix.xlsx (sizing)
